title: ast.symbol_replace response
description: Tagged-union response for ast.symbol_replace. Declaration replacement preserves bytes outside the declaration and inherits its indentation and local line endings. Multiline token bytes in new_text stay verbatim. The rewritten source is re-parsed; if tree-sitter reports an ERROR/MISSING node the call returns syntax_error_after_edit rather than the rewritten source.

source.description: Rewritten source. Set only when `result` is `replaced`.

candidate.description: Uncommitted candidate bytes when post-edit syntax validation rejected the replacement.

details.description: First-line diagnostic from the post-edit re-parse. Set only when `result` is `syntax_error_after_edit`.

health.description: Versioned safe-edit ParserHealth provenance and coverage contract.
